title: New York-based Actively, which offers AI sales agents for account management, raised a $45M Series B co-led by TCV and First Harmonic at a $250M valuation (Sofia Chierchio/Forbes)
summary: Sofia Chierchio / Forbes: New York-based Actively, which offers AI sales agents for account management, raised a $45M Series B co-led by TCV and First Harmonic at a $250M valuation — Actively AI has raised $45 million to scale up its AI sales agents, which can automate a chunk of the work reps typically do manually.
